in_sanskrit.name: Suhil
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Young Sun

It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'suhel', which means 'shining, radiant, or young sun'. The name evokes images of warmth, light, and vitality, making it an excellent choice for a child born during the summer months.
